title: Lytics Collect Event
description: Schema for an event payload submitted to the Lytics data collection endpoint.

_uid.description: Lytics unique user identifier to associate with this event

email.description: User email address (used as identity key)

event.description: Event name or type (e.g., page_view, purchase, login)

title.description: Page or content title associated with this event

ts.description: Event timestamp (ISO 8601). Defaults to server time if omitted.
